ShortDescription.Value: Vehicles pass through pedestrians at building access points - no more clogging at entrances.

LongDescription.Value:
Access Anarchy lets vehicles drive straight through pedestrians at building access points - parking lots, warehouses, cargo terminals, stores - so entrances never clog up while pedestrians keep walking normally.
How it works: zero Harmony patches. The mod edits shared ECS simulation data (pedestrian lane registrations and lane overlap relations near building entrances) instead of patching game methods, following the Anarchy mod philosophy. Car-to-car yielding, pedestrian pathfinding and crosswalk behaviour are untouched.
Options (12 languages): - Scope mode: access zones only (default), or all roads (global). - Per-category toggles: garage ramps, building driveways, parking lots and building-internal lanes.
Compatible with Cities: Skylines II 1.6.x. Source code on GitHub.
